Drummer Danny D’Imperio has thrived in a variety of musical settings including classic jazz with the Salt City Six, big band with Woody Herman and Maynard Ferguson, and hard bop with his own group, The Bloviators. His recordings as a leader include “Glass Enclosure,” “Hip To It” and “Still Comin’ On Up” with The Metropolitan Bopera House.
Danny was interviewed in Cortland, New York, on June 30, 2014, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
